paper.title: Gray-Box Optimization using Optimism in the Face of Uncertainty

settings.name_in_paper: Sequential gray-box optimization (time-varying loss l_n composed with linear-in-parameter model A_n(u)theta)
unmapped: Learner observes a noisy multi-output measurement y_n = A_n(u_n) theta* + v_n of model outputs, not the loss; the loss l_n(u,z) is known
Known convex admissible parameter set Theta containing theta* with ||theta - mu_0||_{Lambda_0} <= c_theta (c_theta known)
Loss Lipschitz in z w.r.t. ||.||_V with constant L_z; instantaneous regret bounded by c_r
Time-varying known loss functions l_n, model maps A_n and action sets U_n (treated as contexts); regret against per-round optimum
Noise sub-Gaussian with proxy variance c_v^2 V^{-1}, c_v known
settings.definition_quote: For $n \in \NsmallerN$, we consider a time-varying input-output model defined by some known matrix-valued function $A_n: \U_n \rightarrow \R^{n_z \times \ntheta}$ and an unknown parameter $\thetatrue \in  \thetaSet \subset \R^{\ntheta}$: y_n = A_n(u_n)\thetatrue + v_n ... R_N = \sum_{n=0}^{N-1} \objective_n(u_n, \thetatrue) - \objective_n(\uopttrue_n, \thetatrue)

unmapped: Action sets U_n may vary with n (not specified how); regret against per-round optimum
settings.definition_quote: Consider the linear bandit problem, i.e. $y = u\T \theta + v$ and $l(u, z) = z$. Suppose Assumption~\ref{ass:subgaussian} holds. ... (ii) $\Vert \thetatrue \Vert_2 \leq c_S$. (iii) $\Vert u \Vert_2 \leq c_L$ ... (iv) $u\T \thetatrue \in [-1, 1]$

settings.name_in_paper: Sequential gray-box optimization with finite action sets
unmapped: As s1 but with finite action sets U_n
Gap Delta_bar_N = min over n of the per-round gap
settings.definition_quote: Suppose the action sets $\U_n$ are finite for all $n \in \NsmallerN$.

algorithms.name: Structure-exploiting optimistic LCB method for gray-box optimization (problem P_n(delta))

symbols.gamma_N: data-dependent confidence radius sqrt(c_theta^2 + c_v^2 logdet_N + 2 c_v^2 log(1/delta))

conditions: Assumptions 1-4: conditionally subgaussian noise with known c_v, convex bounded Theta containing theta*, loss L_z-Lipschitz in z, instantaneous regret <= c_r
global minimizer of P_n(delta) computed each round

source.label: thm:regret-data-dependent
source.quote: If $u_n$ is chosen as a solution to $\problem_n(\delta)$ for all $n \in \NsmallerN$, then the following statement holds with a probability of at least $1-\delta$: R_N \leq \max(c_r, 2 L_z \gamma_N(\delta))  \sqrt{2 N \log\left(\det\left(\Lambda_0\inv \Lambda_{N}\right)\right)}

results.notes: L_z mapped to L_lip; c_v to sigma. Data-dependent bound. Holds w.p. 1-delta.

conditions: Assumptions 1-5 (incl. bounded regressors with constant c_A)

source.quote: then the following data-dependent bound holds with a probability of at least $1-\delta$: R_N \leq \frac{2 \max(c_r, 2 L_z \gamma_N(\delta))^2}{\bar \Delta_N}  \log(\det(\Lambda_0\inv \Lambda_N))

results.notes: Remark 7 extends to polytopic action sets with concave objectives.

symbols.c_A: bound on weighted regressor Frobenius norm
symbols.Delta_bar: min over rounds n of the per-round gap Delta_n

source.label: thm:regret-finite-action-set
source.quote: If, in addition, Assumption~\ref{ass:bounded-regressors} is satisfied, then the following data-independent bound holds with a probability of at least $1-\delta$: R_N \leq \frac{2 \ntheta \max(c_r, 2 L_z \bar \gamma_N(\delta))^2}{\bar \Delta_N}  \log\left(1 + \frac{N c_A^2}{\ntheta}\right)

\expected{}{R_N} \leq b_N(\delta) + \delta N c_r. If $N$ is known a priori, choosing $\delta = \tfrac{1}{N}$ yields an expected regret $\expected{}{R_N}$ of the order $\bigO\left(\sqrt{N} \log(N)\right)$.

results.notes: General statement E[R_N] <= b_N(delta) + delta N c_r. Regret defined through true objective values, hence pseudo-regret.

source.quote: Similarly, under the assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:regret-finite-action-set}, choosing $\delta  = \tfrac{1}{N}$ yields an expected regret $\expected{}{R_N}$ of the order $\bigO\left(\log(N)^2\right)$.
